items.name: GenericByteDictionaryBuilder
items.signature: struct GenericByteDictionaryBuilder<K, T> where K: ArrowDictionaryKeyType, T: ByteArrayType

methods.name: append
methods.signature: fn append(&mut self, value: impl AsRef<T::Native>) -> Result<K::Native, ArrowError>
methods.summary: Append a value to the array. Return an existing index if already present in the values array or a new index if the value is appended to the values array.

methods.name: append_n
methods.signature: fn append_n(&mut self, value: impl AsRef<T::Native>, count: usize) -> Result<K::Native, ArrowError>
methods.summary: Append a value multiple times to the array. This is the same as `append` but allows to append the same value multiple times without doing multiple lookups.

methods.name: append_null
methods.summary: Appends a null slot into the builder

methods.name: append_nulls
methods.summary: Infallibly append `n` null slots into the builder

methods.name: append_option
methods.signature: fn append_option(&mut self, value: Option<impl AsRef<T::Native>>)
methods.summary: Append an `Option` value into the builder

methods.name: append_options
methods.signature: fn append_options(&mut self, value: Option<impl AsRef<T::Native>>, count: usize)
methods.summary: Append an `Option` value into the builder repeatedly `count` times. This is the same as `append_option` but allows to append the same value multiple times without doing multiple lookups.

methods.name: append_value
methods.signature: fn append_value(&mut self, value: impl AsRef<T::Native>)
methods.summary: Infallibly append a value to this builder

methods.name: append_values
methods.signature: fn append_values(&mut self, value: impl AsRef<T::Native>, count: usize)
methods.summary: Infallibly append a value to this builder repeatedly `count` times. This is the same as `append_value` but allows to append the same value multiple times without doing multiple lookups.

methods.name: as_any
methods.summary: Returns the builder as an non-mutable `Any` reference.

methods.name: as_any_mut
methods.summary: Returns the builder as an mutable `Any` reference.

methods.name: extend
methods.signature: fn extend<I: IntoIterator<Item = Option<V>>>(&mut self, iter: I)

methods.name: extend_dictionary
methods.signature: fn extend_dictionary(&mut self, dictionary: &TypedDictionaryArray<'_, K, GenericByteArray<T>>) -> Result<(), ArrowError>
methods.summary: Extends builder with an existing dictionary array.

methods.name: finish
methods.summary: Builds the `DictionaryArray` and reset this builder.

methods.name: finish
methods.summary: Builds the array and reset this builder.

methods.name: finish_cloned
methods.summary: Builds the `DictionaryArray` without resetting the builder.

methods.name: finish_cloned
methods.summary: Builds the array without resetting the builder.

methods.name: finish_preserve_values
methods.summary: Builds the `DictionaryArray` without resetting the values builder or the internal de-duplication map.

methods.name: into_box_any
methods.summary: Returns the boxed builder as a box of `Any`.

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the number of array slots in the builder

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates a new `GenericByteDictionaryBuilder`

methods.name: new_with_dictionary
methods.signature: fn new_with_dictionary(keys_capacity: usize, dictionary_values: &GenericByteArray<T>) -> Result<Self, ArrowError>
methods.summary: Creates a new `GenericByteDictionaryBuilder` from a keys capacity and a dictionary which is initialized with the given values. The indices of those dictionary values are used as keys.

methods.name: try_new_from_builder
methods.signature: fn try_new_from_builder<K2>(source: GenericByteDictionaryBuilder<K2, T>) -> Result<Self, ArrowError> where K::Native: NumCast, K2: ArrowDictionaryKeyType, K2::Native: NumCast
methods.summary: Creates a new `GenericByteDictionaryBuilder` from the existing builder with the same keys and values, but with a new data type for the keys.

methods.name: validity_slice
methods.summary: Returns the current null buffer as a slice

methods.name: with_capacity
methods.signature: fn with_capacity(keys_capacity: usize, value_capacity: usize, data_capacity: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates a new `GenericByteDictionaryBuilder` with the provided capacities
